summary: Vision Brain module (iter 192) tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass for /api/vision/brain/panel, /analyze (force), /notify-explain (news + internal). Frontend: Vision Board loads Accueil Vision by default with 6-pillar Score Business (Vision 40 / Exécution 35 / Finance 100 / Impact 32 / Énergie 75 / Croissance 72, overall 59%), linked-card CA shows '21 600 € / 10 000 €' with 'Objectif atteint' badge, quick actions and activity feed rendered. Persistent AI panel (score, opportunities incl. URSSAF news with 2 clickable sources, actions, modules) visible on Accueil, Canvas and SWOT tabs. Analyze button triggers analysis result panel (incoherences/recommandations). CockpitChat notification flow: news event ('Barème URSSAF') produces 2 sources; internal event ('Nouvelle carte ajoutée') produces 0 sources — matches spec. Vision Board page has opaque background, no Cockpit hero bleed-through.
critical_code_review_comments: vision_brain.py uses raw SQL with backticked `key` (MySQL syntax) against SQLite — works in current tests since SQLite tolerates backticks, but could break if migrated. Consider quoting with double-quotes for portability.
In /panel, when delta==0 the code silently rewrites it to 4 (line 194) which fakes a positive movement; acceptable for demo but should be flagged/removed before prod.
hot_prospect SELECT uses `COALESCE(score,0) AS s` but ORDER BY s DESC will fail on backends where `score` column doesn't exist; the try/except handles it, fine.

Header bell dropdown shows 0 items with data-testid prefix 'notif-' for the demo account — either no seeded notifications or list items lack the testid; UI event dispatch works correctly. Consider seeding 1-2 demo notifications so the click-through flow is user-testable.
seed_data_creation: None (Thomas demo account already seeded with finance_entries producing CA=21 600 €).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_vision_brain_iter192.py can be reused. Frontend notification list is empty for demo account; test the chat integration via window event dispatch 'zayado:open-cockpit-chat' with detail.notif={title,body,kind}.
